issues.detail: The Hebrew 'זַכּוּר בֶּן אִמְרִי' means 'Zaccur son of Imri', but the Chinese renders '以未利人的兒子撒刻' which introduces '以未利人' (a people/ethnic group) not present in the Hebrew; 'אִמְרִי' is a personal name 'Imri', not a gentilic. This changes the identity of the father from a person to a people group.
